label: Drawing the grid
subgoals: Draw a horizontal and a vertical line through each pin
Count distinct x and distinct y coordinates
Multiply them to get the number of grid points

label: Candidate Steiner points
subgoals: Subtract the pins from the grid points
Restrict Steiner points to these candidates
Use at most n - 2 Steiner points

label: The Hanan grid as a graph
section: The Hanan grid as a graph
subgoals: Join neighbouring grid points with weighted edges
Solve the Steiner problem as a graph Steiner tree on this grid
